request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only his clothes and the bomb: the red cap becomes a dented rusted iron pot helmet, keeping the goggles on its front; the red tunic becomes warm dark brown patched hide with a black shoulder strap with hazard yellow diagonal stripes; the black bomb gets a wide band of hazard yellow and black stripes and a red-orange fuse spark. Keep his olive green skin, the face, ears, raised bomb, satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
